text_block_list.text: Look, there's treasure near the river!
text_block_list.name: Girl with pigtails

text_block_list.text:
Treasure?! Wait... I've been had! 
During my training, even... Geez!
text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'm sorry! Heh... Tap,
you look happy recently, 
and you're so focused on racing.
...Before long, you 
won't be coming here anymore, right?
text_block_list.name: Girl with pigtails

text_block_list.text:
You, and the rest of us...
We'll be seeing each other 
a lot less...
I guess we'll talk over LANE.
text_block_list.name: Girl with pigtails

text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, what are you saying?! 
We'll have fun together until the end of
time!
text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City

text_block_list.text:
Haha, you exaggerate. 
Do you really think that's gonna happen?
text_block_list.name: Girl with pigtails

text_block_list.text:
Whether the world will end or not... 
Eventually we'll all graduate from school.
text_block_list.name: Girl with pigtails

text_block_list.text:
I'm looking over documents that I gathered
while 
researching Tap Dance City's runner
strategy.

One of the most legendary runners has to
be 
Silence Suzuka.
Her spectacular record at the 
Kinko Sho still stands to this day.
choice_data_list: To be even better than that...

text_block_list.text:
And I'm going to bring them to fruition!
How about it?
text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City

text_block_list.text:
I shake my head. At that moment,
I just couldn't refuse. 
Now I'm here collecting data to make a plan
for her.
choice_data_list: I'm still feeling out our bond.
I'm still feeling out our bond.

text_block_list.text: Yeah! The day has come! A race of me versus all of you!
text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City

text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.name: Tap's Friends

text_block_list.text:
Yo, Trainer!
What's your plan to steer my path?
text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City

text_block_list.text:
From what I gathered,
none of them are assertive 
enough to run far ahead.
It's looking like the race 
will develop at a slow pace.

Okay... 12.4 seconds per furlong... 
You've brought out your usual level of detail,
eh?
text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City

text_block_list.text:
And I have to destroy the others through my
stamina? You 
think I've got the strength,
let alone brains to timekeep?
text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
choice_data_list: I do. That's why I made this plan.
I do. That's why I made this plan.

text_block_list.text: Great! I'm glad I ran so much for you. I'll be sailing to my heart's content, over the waves you laid out for me!
text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City

text_block_list.text: Thus, the race begins...

Ugh! I can't...! 
This speed...!
text_block_list.name: Horsegirl with sunglasses

text_block_list.text:
The success of this plan was a big
gamble. 
Using speed to create a gap early on...
Haaa!
text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City

text_block_list.text:
Seeing her accelerate even more on the final
stretch, it's like a dream come true.
I'm starting to feel like she'd 
be able to make any future plans come true
as well.

I'm astonished by Tap Dance City's excellent
display of 
the runner strategy,

I'm sure that she'll be able to surpass 
the runners of the past!
choice_data_list: (I will make her the strongest lea...
(I will make her the strongest lea...

text_block_list.text:
*huff* *huff* Whadda ya think, Trainer? 
Will I be able to be "the world's greatest
horsegirl?"
text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
choice_data_list: Yes, I'm sure of it now.
Yes, I'm sure of it now.

text_block_list.text:
Bye-bye, Tap! 
That was a lot of fun!
text_block_list.name: Girl with pigtails

text_block_list.text: "Bye-bye"...? ...Sorry, Trainer! Hey, hold on!
text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Tap? ...And your trainer, too? 
Why'd you follow me?
text_block_list.name: Girl with pigtails

text_block_list.text:
You just left all of a sudden. 
Hey, you've been acting a bit weird for some
time...
text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City

text_block_list.text:
... We... We can't be together forever. 
I thought it was time to say goodbye.
text_block_list.name: Girl with pigtails

text_block_list.text:
You see...
I got a C on the mock exam for the
university I want to go to...
So my mom arranged for me to go 
to cram school starting tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Girl with pigtails

text_block_list.text:
...And?
It's not like you won't have any free
time. 
And what about after the exams are over?
text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City

text_block_list.text:
Tap... It's not like we'll be kids forever.
You should be 
a bit more realistic,
or you'll never grow up.
text_block_list.name: Girl with pigtails

text_block_list.text:
You should act a bit more realistic.
You're an adult. 
What you're going for is like a child's
dream.
text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
Haha! I see... More realistic...
More realistic! Yeah, 
of course! Realistically,
us breaking up is inevitable!
text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City

text_block_list.text:
Farewells happen at many turning points in
life. 
Graduating, getting employed, moving,
arguments...

Pu-hah! Hahaha! I get it, I get it. 
So...
How about we continue "realistically."
text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Girl with pigtails

text_block_list.text:
Think about it.
All our paths are starting to diverge.
All 
we need is a means,
a place and a time to meet up again!
text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City

text_block_list.text:
All we need is the power of money,
and our paths 
will meet again! ...Am I wrong?
text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City

text_block_list.text:
Of course,
you don't need to worry about the money! 
I'm gonna build the most amazing castle for
us all!
text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City

text_block_list.text:
All I need now is a ship. 
Hey, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City

text_block_list.text:
Let me ask you again. 
Will I be able to be "the world's greatest
horsegirl?"
text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
